summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn: the owner's home and garden sit among creek, lake and activity sites, with roads to Hearthmere and Lumenvale and a new market-town square to the north. Authored scene rows anchor places and actors; terrain marks, seeded procedural builders, and shared behaviors supply landscape, crowds, animals, and interactions.
places: places/main - forest world joining Spawn/home and creek, lake/pond islet, garden grounds, and roads west to Hearthmere and east to Lumenvale
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn hub: home, creekside deck/willow/waterwheel, pond-falls cascade, garden/mandala, activity sites, tower, zipline, and road/trailside/trade dressing

places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake shore and pond islet with fishing, maze, north-shore orchard/camp/lookout, west sheep-and-alpaca pasture, horse pasture, plus newer islet-life, blossom-walk and corral blueprint rows
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - north market-town square: blueprint square with managed townsfolk crowd and Ember the roosting dragon at the town hall
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared authored placements for roads and city structures; other cells carry streamed structures and actors
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain and water, site/path/clearing marks, road/shoulder grading, and seeded vegetation layers
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene + x1z0.scene - western/eastern highway verge with distributed trail-stop and flower-basket lamp placements
places/main/cells/x-8z-4.scene - Hearthmere town placement among the streamed city cells
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main place, camera/player templates, arrival behavior, input actions and UI renderer
templates/player.js#player - player root with movement, locomotion, interaction, delete, travel and alchemy handlers
places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain height/material interface and configured landscape marks
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - Spawn's tree-centered multilevel home and furnishings
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene#west-pasture - pasture fence/barn and sheep/alpaca flock manager site; pasture-site separately owns horse herd
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene#town-crowd, #town-dragon - town-square citizen manager and Ember actor; town-square itself remains a blueprint
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - procedural structure roots for Hearthmere and Lumenvale
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt(ctx)/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded vegetation geometry reused by configured decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js + scripts/lib/solid-kit.js - shared solid/collider construction for road and site builders
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and interaction tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - mount/seat/dismount coordination for Violet, rowboat, courier horse and zipline trolley
scripts/lib/data/hearth-city.js + travel/courier data - city layout, destinations and courier routing shared by builders, behaviors and UI
scripts/lib/data/alchemy.js + pond.js + zipline.js - centralized recipe, lake activity and trolley tuning for behavior/UI consumers
scripts/lib/data/town-crowd.yml + town-crowd.js; pasture-flock.yml + pasture-flock.js - roster/tuning-driven town and sheep/alpaca manager behaviors
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - update(ctx,dt)
scripts/ui.js - default(ctx, player), HUD for travel, courier, secrets and alchemy
scripts/town-crowd.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt), ears.press; scripts/pasture-flock.js - update(ctx)
scripts/town-dragon.js - onSpawn(ctx), updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt); scripts/mailbox.js - ears.press, lower(ctx)
scripts/gen/pond-falls.js, pasture-field.js, trade-road.js, north-camp.js, creekside.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx) site builders
scripts/material-falls-water.js, material-wheel-turn.js, material-willow-sway.js - material(ctx) GPU animation materials
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed/material bands, water/site/path marks, clearings, grading and scatter layers
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored IDs, transforms, tags, initial state, parent-child relationships and fixed placements
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - player movement intent, velocity, jump, flight, rope and camera mode; movement scratch remains in ctx.session
scripts/alchemy-player.js + alchemy data - player harvest spending, alchemy panel/toast, buff expiry and speedMul; player consumes speedMul
scripts/pond-seed.js + fishing-tackle.js + pond data - player seeds/gotSeeds and fish count; seed visibility/respawn and fishing cast/catch state
scripts/pasture-flock.js + pasture-flock.yml - west-pasture manager's flock goals, movement/clip state and grazing sounds for rows tagged pasture-flock
scripts/town-crowd.js + town-crowd.yml - crowd manager's spawned townspeople and per-person movement, pose, press response and vendor/tag state; town-dragon.js owns Ember's action/roar timers
scripts/ui.js - presentation of player state and place courier status; it renders values but does not own gameplay state
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
terrain site/path marks + decoration layers -> grading, clearing, ground materials and seeded vegetation; scene rows independently draw roads and structures
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; templates/player.js also attaches home interaction, travel and alchemy handlers
player presses mandala-crystal -> harvest; alchemy-bench press -> alchemyOpen -> alchemy-player brew spends harvest and sets buff -> scripts/ui.js presents panel/status
pond seed trigger / pouch press -> scripts/pond-seed.js -> player seeds and gotSeeds; fishing-tackle press/cast/reel -> player fish count and catch feedback
west-pasture manager + pasture-flock.yml -> tagged sheep/alpaca rows' target positions and species clips; animation clips are registered in world.facts.yaml
town-crowd.yml roster -> town-crowd.js seeds townspeople under the square manager; citizen pressTo routes press to manager -> nearest person turns/answers with speech feedback
town-dragon.js schedule -> Ember skeleton/pose actions and roar/FX emissions; scripts/gen/roost-dragon.js supplies rig geometry and skeleton
house-mailbox press -> scripts/mailbox.js selects state.letters, flips primitive.params.flag, and emits player-targeted text plus rustle sound -> lower(ctx) resets flag
creekside parent scene rows -> shared creekside geometry; willow/rush GPU sway and wheel-turn materials animate without per-row behavior ticks
pond-falls rock/water builders + material-falls-water -> cascade structure, curtains and animated water at creek mouth; attached FX/audio layer completes waterfall
travel input/actions -> scripts/travel.js + travel data -> player travel state/teleport; scripts/ui.js renders destination list and emits travelGo
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest flora varied by layer, kind and terrain; broadleaf spring foliage, fir sizes and hollow logs now mix in
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - tree-centered multilevel home and furnishing family varied by item, dimensions, palette and seed
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed; terrain roads separately supply irregular cobble/gravel edges and shoulders
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - perimeter runs/gates vary by points, width and style, including coursed limestone wall details
animal builders + fauna-ground.js / fauna-small.js; animal-sheep.js and animal-alpaca.js + pasture-flock.js add a manager-driven grazing flock family
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + hearth-city data; scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - procedural city structures/lots varied by city layout and kind
scripts/gen/shore-kit.js + material-shore-sway.js; creekside willow/rushes and wheel use dedicated sway/turn materials with shared geometry
scripts/gen/{north-camp,pond-falls,trade-road,trail-stop,pasture-field,creekside}.js - reusable site/prop families varied by kind, parts, points and placement
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).

Keep terrain material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placement; Spawn/home grounds are near (0,-27), pasture flatten/clear centers at (-38,-73), and new town clearings center on z=108 and lane z=45.

Terrain path marks grade/materialize routes and clear scatter; scene road/path builders draw visible paving and do not replace terrain jobs. Keep road-east/west shoulders and market fan marks coordinated with road dressing and courier road keys.

The west-pasture flock manager discovers rows by pasture-flock tag and keeps goals inside its fence polygon; preserve matching actor tags, fence points, manager site and registered species clip names.
Sage's route in scripts/lib/data/sage.yml is measured against colliders and consumed by sage-route.js; keep its authored route coordinated with sage clips and behavior.
Zipline state.a/state.b are world endpoints and s/sag tuning is in metres; it seats through dragon-rider and drops the rider at the configured end, so retain endpoint/seat/drop coordination.
